test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Sonal Mansingh, Padma Bhushan and Padma Vibhushan awardee, is an accomplished dancer of which of the following dances in addition to the Bharatanatyam?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odissi.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Sonal Mansingh is a prominent Indian classical dancer who specializes in Bharatanatyam and Odissi.
 
• For her contributions to promoting ‘Classical dances’, she has received accolades from many national and international organizations.
 
• She was the youngest recipient of Padma Bhushan in 1992.
 
• In 2003, Sonal became the first Indian woman dancer to be awarded Padma Vibhushan.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**Odissi Dance:

__
 
• Odissi is a folk dance form of Odisha.

 
• This is a delicate dance backed by soothing lyrics and Is similar to Bharatnatyam in terms of Mudras and Expressions.
 
• The cave of Udayagiri-Khandagiri provides the earliest example of Odissi.
 
• It was primarily practiced by Maharis under patrons of Jain King Kheravela.
 
• "Mobile Sculpture" includes two major postures:
 
 
• Tribhanga - The body is deflected at the neck, torso, and knees.
 
• Chowk - A position imitating a square.
 
 
 
• Indrani Rehman, Charles Fabri, Guru Pankaj Charan Das, and Kelu Charan Mohapatra are some of the famous artists of Odissi dance
